race.comment: CLAYMORE MINE (6) lines up for the first time since August 1. Started the last campaign impressively when in the placings over 1200m at Ballarat, which was one of 5 top-three finishes from 6 first-up runs. Went around in better races than this at most starts last prep, so form better than it reads. ICED POPPY (1) produced a reasonable effort when second last start over 1000m at Pakenham Synthetic. That followed a win at Bendigo the start prior. In contention this time. THE FLYING POPOV (5) gave away a considerable start over 1300m at Geelong last time before hitting the line well to finish sixth. Solid top-three prospects. OCEANELLA (9) has logged back-to-back wins this prep and rises in grade here but confidence is obviously so, so reluctant to dismiss.
